text_block_list.text:
After winning many races with Agnes 
Tachyon, while I was basking in the 
lingering excitement for a moment—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer-kun. Regarding that item... 
do you still have it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You know, that thing I just happened to 
win at the shopping street.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You didn't seem to be away from the 
academy, so I imagine it's probably here.

Hearing "just happened to win it at the 
shopping street" brings back memories. 
Come to think of it, I once won a hot 
springs trip voucher from a shopping 
street raffle too.
choice_data_list: I do have hot spring trip tickets, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All right, it's settled. We're leaving for 
the hot springs trip right now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't 'huh' me. You wouldn't want it to 
expire and turn into just a useless piece 
of paper, would you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now that you understand, make haste.

I feel like she used to say that traveling 
was nothing but a hassle, but—

At any rate, completely swept up in Agnes 
Tachyon's momentum, I ended up going on a 
hot spring trip with her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Transferring trains while hauling around 
all this heavy luggage... This is way more 
of a pain than I thought...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Just the way things are," huh... Hmm.

"After transferring trains a few times, we 
finally arrived at the inn."
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... hot springs really are scorching 
hot.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, how about you? Did you get any healing 
effects from it?

The hot spring after such a long train 
ride was far more relaxing than I'd 
imagined.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ho, I see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Is it muscle relaxation from the thermal 
heat, recovery from the hot spring 
minerals, or perhaps—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...No, at any rate, if it produced good 
results, then all is well."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
After this is dinner. I've arranged to 
have it prepared in your room, so please 
go ahead and wait there.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops, the food's already here? Is that 
huge thing... spiny lobster?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
They say the abundant taurine in spiny 
lobster works wonders for fatigue, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Considering the fatigue that comes from 
cracking open such a hard shell, it almost 
feels pointless..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's eat anyway. Be a dear and peel 
the spiny lobster for me, will you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, just eating that tired me out... 
...Though, the spiny lobster was 
surprisingly delicious.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And what about you? You look reasonably 
satisfied.

"Enjoying a traditional kaiseki meal in a 
quiet place away from work. Honestly, it 
was a great way to unwind."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ho, so the tryptophan consumed earlier has 
converted into serotonin, inducing 
feelings of happiness?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Or... hmm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm about to ask you a rather strange 
question, if that's all right?"

"I thought asking weird questions was 
business as usual, but—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Why... were you "satisfied"?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You have a look on your face like you're 
at a loss for a reason. Well then... shall 
I try to guess it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Today, we went through quite a bit of 
effort, from packing our bags to 
transferring between trains.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ordinarily, extra effort should be nothing 
more than a nuisance, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Within the special time of a trip, all 
those small hassles become 'experiences'—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Has it not, in fact, increased your 
current happiness ...or something along 
those lines?

I'm left a little taken aback by such an 
uncharacteristic remark from her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, that's quite a surprised look on 
your face.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The old me certainly never would have 
thought that going through extra trouble 
could become experience.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, after experiencing various things 
over these past three years, I arrived at 
a new hypothesis.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's easy to dismiss things as too much 
hassle or a pain.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, within the things you cast aside 
like that, there may have been new 
possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Then going forward, I'd like to explore 
the possibilities in things like that 
too."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Today's trip was to verify that. And the 
result is right before our eyes."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Despite having gone through all this 
hassle, you're still enjoying yourself, 
aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Full of energy and vigor, just as 
my guinea pig should be!

That day, I spent quite a while talking 
about various things with Agnes Tachyon.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Agnes Tachyon...
